objectClass.notes: Four admitted elevations support a stylized exterior-only reconstruction; no interior geometry is inferred.

reasoning: The narrow tower, offset balcony, horned roof, lantern jib, and banner create a strongly interrupted asymmetric silhouette.
Repeated plank seams, shingles, iron plates, bolts, windows, and finials require grouped systems to stay inside the 4,400-triangle target.
Four admitted views resolve the exterior depth, but their generated ornamental cadence varies slightly, so front and hero views control identity.

specDepthDecision.rationale: Macro tower masses, meso service assemblies, and grouped micro construction details all survive at the elevated gameplay camera.

resolvedUncertainties: Generated views disagree on minor horn and rope placement; use the front and hero horn silhouette, with the rear view controlling rope anchors.
Shingle, bolt, and stone counts are cadence evidence rather than literal counts; use grouped repetition under the 5,600-triangle hard ceiling.
Lantern interior, doorway interior, and balcony room interior remain closed or emissive-backed exterior surfaces.

detailInventory.note: Twelve observed details are mapped to implemented component local features or material local overrides.

details.description: Green moss concentrates in the lowest irregular foundation joints and post bases.
details.affects: stone albedo, roughness, and cavity response

details.description: Chunky damp-stone courses use uneven widths rather than a uniform brick grid.
Tall vertical plank rhythm is framed by dark posts and cross rails on every elevation.
Diagonal timber braces interrupt the tall wall panels and reinforce the balcony.
Square iron corner plates and raised bolt heads repeat at beams, posts, and door rails.
details.affects: metal construction rhythm and edge highlights

details.description: Overlapping oxidized teal shingle rows step down both steep roof slopes.
details.affects: roof row relief and teal value variation

details.description: Paired dark horn forms flare outward from the upper eaves with metal collar bands.
Small amber arched windows carry dark vertical and horizontal mullions.
details.affects: window material separation and facade scale

details.description: The hanging amber lantern is enclosed by a tapered iron cage and short chain.
details.affects: lantern negative space and emissive containment

details.description: Warm amber core remains contained inside the iron lantern cage.
A round iron door pull and pointed post caps anchor the service entrance.
The blank teal banner ends in an uneven torn lower edge without an emblem.

anatomy.note: Architectural object; character anatomy does not apply.

definitionOfDone: A floor-seated 7.8 by 10.5 by 7 yard exterior shell reads immediately as the horned Fenwarden tower from four gameplay-relevant angles, retains a clear service stair and balcony, and remains within the 4,400-triangle target and 5,600 hard ceiling.

antiShallowSpecRules: Do not model an explorable or visible interior.
Do not replace horn arcs, balcony negative space, or stair profile with painted details.
Every inventoried mark must resolve to a named component feature or material override.
Use grouped or instanced repetition for shingles, bolts, windows, and finials.
Keep +Z as the front and preserve the unobstructed service apron.
